number.why: HR 0.81 (0.71-0.94) is the Hokusai-VTE principal safety outcome (major or CRNM bleeding), edoxaban vs warfarin, safety analysis set. The registry reports 0.81 (0.705-0.936).

quotes.span: The principal safety outcome was major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding.
The safety outcome occurred in 349 patients (8.5%) in the edoxaban group and 423 patients (10.3%) in the warfarin group (hazard ratio, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.94; P=0.004 for superiority).

entry.why: Adults with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or symptomatic PE; comparator warfarin.
